_comment: Agent alias → session UUID mapping. Used by scripts/last-message.py via `just last <alias>`, scripts/groups-lookup.py via `just groups` / `just wait-for-brief`, and the `just crew` / `just pulse` dashboards. UUIDs are session IDs from your AI tool's session storage (Claude Code: ~/.claude/projects/<project-slug>/<uuid>.jsonl). Run `just discover-sessions` to list recent JSONLs and find UUIDs for new aliases.

_storage._comment: Optional override for non-Claude-Code tools. Default is Claude Code's ~/.claude/projects/<project-slug>/.

_colors_in_use._comment: Optional but recommended: track seat colors to avoid collisions. Claude Code's /color command accepts: red, blue, green, yellow, purple, orange, pink, cyan, default.

groups._comment: Role-based groups for inbox addressing. `just broadcast <from> <slug> [group]` writes a -to-<group>- brief; `just wait-for-brief <alias>` wakes on briefs addressed to any group the alias belongs to. Members are alias keys from 'aliases' below (validated by `just groups`).

crew.description: All active participants. Broadcasts addressed to 'crew' wake every seat. Add alias keys to 'members' as seats register.

aliases._comment_aliases: Examples — replace with your project's agents. Minimal entry: {uuid, role}. Recommended (seat/occupant doctrine): the SEAT is the persistent identity — display_name, color, mission — and OUTLIVES its occupant; the OCCUPANT is whichever model currently holds the seat — model records reality, model_note records what happened (reroutes, deprecations, suspensions). When occupancy changes, update model/model_note and keep the seat.

_example_seat.role: Example Seat — short mission statement shown by `just aliases` so humans and agents understand who-is-who
_example_seat.color_note: Optional: why this color (seats pick their own name and color — the choice is the occupant's, including declining to choose)
_example_seat.model_note: Seat founded YYYY-MM-DD by <model> (first occupant). Update on occupancy changes; never re-found the seat.
